_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% 12h movement rate over 7 days and analyst's 0/8 directional record make HOLD the statistically honest call — the macro scaffolding is there but the coil has not broken and forcing a directional guess in this regime is how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: Partially — both see eventual upside toward Hope, but analyst explicitly conditions it on ETF/funding breakers that have not fired, while narrative frames it as more imminent
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows cross above 55 with funding rising above 0.005% and BTC momentum 30d pushing past 60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY strength returning above 101 and BTC exchange reserves dropping sharply as coins move to exchanges
